subject: General Knowledge
title: Class 10 General Knowledge Olympiad — Paper 1
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: What is the national animal of India?
Which organ of the United Nations is responsible for maintaining international peace and security?
Which gas makes up the largest proportion of Earth's atmosphere?
Complete the series: J, F, M, A, M, __ (first letters of months)
Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
What is the currency of Japan?
Which Indian city is known as the 'Silicon Valley of India'?
Which continent is known as the 'Dark Continent'?
Which is the tallest mountain peak in the world?
Which Indian monument is one of the Seven Wonders of the World?
Find the odd one out: Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Himalayas
options: Himalayas (a mountain range, others are cities)

questions.question: Who is regarded as the Father of the Nation in India?
Who composed India's national song 'Vande Mataram'?
The Sun rises in which direction?
If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 10 days?
Which is the largest state in India by area?
Which Indian festival is known as the 'Festival of Lights'?
Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
Which Indian state is the largest producer of tea?
Which is the highest civilian award in India?
Which day is observed worldwide as International Yoga Day?

options: A joint tournament hosted by USA, Canada, and Mexico

questions.question: What is the theme focus of the G20 summit when India held its presidency in 2023?
options: 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam' (One Earth, One Family, One Future)

questions.question: Which Indian mission successfully carried out India's first human spaceflight test preparations, named 'Gaganyaan'?
Who is the current Prime Minister of India (as of 2026)?
Who is the current Vice-President of India (as of 2026)?
What does 'G20' refer to in international affairs?
options: A group of 20 major world economies that meet to discuss global economic issues
A trade agreement between 20 Asian nations

questions.question: Which country hosted the 2024 Summer Olympics?
The 2026 Winter Olympics are being hosted by which country?
Who is the current President of India (as of 2026)?
Which Indian sporting event is held every four years and includes athletics, swimming, and other sports among Commonwealth nations?
Which organization is responsible for global public health matters, headquartered in Geneva?
Which mission is India's space agency ISRO known for landing near the Moon's south pole in 2023?
Which action best demonstrates good leadership in a group activity?
options: Making all decisions alone without input
Listening to everyone's ideas and making fair decisions

questions.question: A team project is falling behind schedule because members are not communicating. What is the best solution?
options: Let one person do all the work silently
Hold a team meeting to redistribute tasks and set clear communication channels

questions.question: Which quality is most important when accepting constructive criticism?
options: Openness to learning and improving without taking it personally
Avoiding the person who gave feedback

questions.question: Which habit best reflects empathy towards others?
options: Ignoring others' feelings to focus only on yourself
Trying to understand how someone else feels in a situation

questions.question: If a classmate is being bullied, what is the most responsible action to take?
options: Ignore it since it's not your problem
Join in to avoid being targeted yourself
Record it and share it online
Support the classmate and report it to a trusted teacher or adult

questions.question: What is the best way to handle a disagreement with a friend?
options: Talk calmly and listen to their perspective
Involve other friends to take sides
Argue loudly until they agree with you

questions.question: What is an effective way to manage stress before a big test?
options: Practicing deep breathing and staying organized with preparation

questions.question: What is the healthiest way to cope with failure in an exam?
options: Reflecting on mistakes and creating a plan to improve

questions.question: Which behaviour best shows responsible digital citizenship?
options: Ignoring privacy settings on social media
Posting personal details of others without consent
Verifying information before sharing it online
Sharing any information without checking its accuracy

questions.question: Which of these best demonstrates good time management before an exam?
options: Creating a study schedule and following it consistently
Depending only on classroom notes without review

questions.question: A region invests heavily in renewable energy sources like solar and wind over the next decade. What is a likely long-term outcome for that region?
options: Immediate elimination of all energy costs
Reduced dependence on fossil fuels and lower long-term carbon emissions

questions.question: During a natural disaster like a flood, why is it important for communities to have an early warning system?
options: It replaces the need for emergency services
It allows people time to evacuate and take precautions, reducing loss of life and property
It prevents the flood from occurring

questions.question: If a country's currency value drops sharply against other currencies, what is a likely effect on its imports and exports?
options: Both imports and exports become cheaper
Both imports and exports become more expensive
Imports become more expensive while exports become cheaper for foreign buyers
There is no effect on trade

questions.question: A country's literacy rate has been steadily rising over the past decade due to increased investment in schools. What long-term impact would this most likely have on the nation's economy?
options: A more skilled workforce, potentially boosting economic growth and innovation
A decrease in the availability of jobs
No impact on the economy at all

questions.question: Two neighbouring countries share a river as a water source, and one builds a large dam upstream. What is a likely diplomatic concern this could raise?
options: Only environmental groups would be concerned, not governments
There would be no effect since rivers regenerate water instantly
The upstream country loses all rights to the river
The downstream country may face reduced water flow, leading to disputes over water sharing
